Name: Stone & Beam Rylee Modern Bookcase 39.4"Wx76.8”H, Mixed Gray
A wide profile, a mixed-gray finish, and 8 asymmetrical niches make this bookcase as eye-catching as it is functional. Store your collection in the open niches, or use the 4 built-in drawers with soft-closing hinges to maximize your office or library space. 39.4”W x 13.8”D x 76.8”H Wood A beautiful finish and asymmetrical design make this bookcase as visually interesting as it is functional Soft-closing hinges, asymmetrical niches, and four built-in drawers store your collection in style. No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
